detailsNote: Official annual dates available; Fall 2027 year not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall priority
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual priority; international applicants should complete current degree byMay 1.

applicationFee.note: International$75; US citizens/permanent residents$45. Program cannot offer application fee waivers.

english.toefl: 80 legacy;4.0 new overall and every subscore
english.note: Also PTE 58/Cambridge 176. Official agency reports, valid at program start. Educational exemption needs qualifying accredited English-medium degree, GPA 2.7, or qualifying US coursework; documentation reviewed. Research-only graduate degrees without coursework do not qualify.

requirements.note: Four-year bachelor equivalent, GPA 3; life-science coursework and research recommended. Select Biomedical Science Program then research track. No prior mentor needed; first-year rotations before mutual mentor choice. Foreign evaluation from ECE, IEE, SpanTran orWES required.

funding.note: Program states all PhDs receive current$28,000 annual stipend, tuition waiver, health insurance; domestic/international eligibility in good standing. No required TA duties. Future stipend amount unconfirmed.
